description.en:
Basic Attack

Aalto fires up to 5 consecutive shots, dealing Aero DMG. Basic Attack 4 will spread the Mist forward, which lasts for 1.5s.

Heavy Attack

Aalto enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.
The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Aalto consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Aalto menembakkan hingga 5 tembakan beruntun, memberikan Aero DMG. Basic Attack 4 menyebarkan Mist ke depan, yang bertahan selama 1,5 dtk.

Heavy Attack

Aalto memasuki kondisi membidik untuk tembakan yang lebih kuat.
Tembakan bidikan yang dilepaskan setelah pengisian selesai memberikan Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Aalto mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan tembakan beruntun ke target di udara, memberikan Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
Mist Avatar

Casts Mist and 1 "Mist Avatar(s)" to taunt the surrounding targets. The avatars inherit a portion of Aalto's HP and generate 6 Mist Bullets around them, dealing Aero DMG.

Mist Bullets

Deals Aero DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
description.id:
Mist Avatar

Melancarkan Mist dan 1 "Mist Avatar" untuk memancing perhatian target di sekitar. Avatar mewarisi sebagian HP Aalto dan menghasilkan 6 Mist Bullets di sekelilingnya, memberikan Aero DMG.

Mist Bullets

Memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

description.en: Generate a Gate of Quandary in front, dealing Aero DMG. When bullets pass through the Gate of Quandary, they deal increased DMG. Gate of Quandary lasts for 10s.
description.id: Menciptakan Gate of Quandary di depan, memberikan Aero DMG. Saat peluru melewati Gate of Quandary, peluru memberikan DMG yang meningkat. Gate of Quandary bertahan selama 10 dtk.

description.en: Aalto's Heavy Attack will always critically hit, triggered once every 30s.
description.id: Heavy Attack Aalto selalu menghasilkan critical hit, aktif sekali setiap 30 dtk.

description.en: Aalto will continuously recover STA when he is in the Forte Circuit Mistcloak Dash state.
description.id: Aalto terus memulihkan STA saat berada dalam kondisi Forte Circuit Mistcloak Dash.

description.en: Aalto shows up out of thin air to perform rapid continuous shooting, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id: Aalto muncul tiba-tiba untuk melakukan tembakan beruntun yang cepat, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
When Aalto passes through "Mist" or "Gate of Quandary", he enters the Mistcloak Dash.

Mistcloak Dash

-Movement speed increased;
-During this period, "Mist Drops" are continuously consumed, and for each 1 "Mist Drop" consumed, 1 Mist Bullet(s) is generated.

Mist Drops

Aalto can hold up to 6 "Mist Drops".
When Basic Attack or Mid-air Attack passes through "Mist" and hits the target, 1 "Mist Drop" is recovered.
description.id:
Saat Aalto melewati "Mist" atau "Gate of Quandary", ia memasuki Mistcloak Dash.

Mistcloak Dash

-Kecepatan gerak meningkat;
-Selama periode ini, "Mist Drops" terus dikonsumsi, dan setiap 1 "Mist Drop" yang dikonsumsi menghasilkan 1 Mist Bullet.

Mist Drops

Aalto dapat menyimpan hingga 6 "Mist Drops".
Saat Basic Attack atau Mid-air Attack melewati "Mist" dan mengenai target, 1 "Mist Drop" dipulihkan.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Memiliki peluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Aero DMG Amplified by 23% for 14s or until they are switched out.
description.id: Resonator yang masuk mendapat Amplify Aero DMG sebesar 23% selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: The cooldown of Resonance Skill Shift Trick is reduced by 4s.
description.id: Cooldown Resonance Skill Shift Trick berkurang 4 dtk.

description.en: "Mist Avatar" inherits 100% more HP from Aalto. When Aalto attacks targets taunted by the "Mist Avatar(s)", his ATK is increased by 15%.
description.id: "Mist Avatar" mewarisi 100% lebih banyak HP dari Aalto. Saat Aalto menyerang target yang terpancing oleh "Mist Avatar", ATK-nya meningkat sebesar 15%.

description.en: When Aalto's Basic Attack or Mid-air Attack passes through the Mist, 2 more bullets will be generated, dealing 50% of the DMG of Basic Attack or Mid-air Attack.
description.id: Saat Basic Attack atau Mid-air Attack Aalto melewati Mist, 2 peluru tambahan dihasilkan, memberikan 50% dari DMG Basic Attack atau Mid-air Attack.

description.en: The damage of Resonance Skill Mist Bullets is increased by 30%; Aalto receives 30% less DMG in his Forte Circuit Mistcloak Dash state.
description.id: DMG Resonance Skill Mist Bullets meningkat sebesar 30%; Aalto menerima 30% lebih sedikit DMG saat dalam kondisi Forte Circuit Mistcloak Dash.

description.en: In the Forte Circuit Mistcloak Dash state, Aalto's Aero DMG Bonus is increased by 25% for 6s.
description.id: Dalam kondisi Forte Circuit Mistcloak Dash, Aero DMG Bonus Aalto meningkat sebesar 25% selama 6 dtk.

description.en: Resonance Liberation Flower in the Mist now additionally increases Crit. Rate by 8%. When Aalto's Heavy Attack passes through the Gate of Quandary, the damage dealt is additionally increased by 50%.
description.id: Resonance Liberation Flower in the Mist kini juga meningkatkan Crit. Rate sebesar 8%. Saat Heavy Attack Aalto melewati Gate of Quandary, DMG yang diberikan meningkat tambahan sebesar 50%.
